the development of a novel bone substitute material for the treatment of bone defects.
the use of a new synthetic bone grafting material, EthOss, which is a composite of β-tricalcium-phosphate and calcium sulfate, as a bone graft substitute in the repair of cranial defects.
the development of new bone grafting materials for bone regeneration in craniofacial defects.

the novel bone grafting material β-TCP/ CS performed as well as a bovine xenogeneic bone graft, and better than spontaneous healing.

the novel β-TTCP/CS grafting materials performed well as a bone substitute in this animal model.
